en: Sepia photograph of a church with multiple spires and a clock tower behind a gated arch and tile‑roofed houses, set against wooded hills. The front caption lists the city in Romanian, Hungarian, and German. The reverse has Romanian handwriting and address lines, three Romanian stamps (including an aviation stamp and a blue 'Pentru Cultură' stamp), and postmarks dated 30 July 1932. Printed text on the back identifies the scene as St. Nicholas Church.
